note: THE STEP SHAPES u0-subr-x-thread-macros does not reach. Emacs answers (-10 -10 5 (1 2 3) (3 1 2)): a step that is a BARE SYMBOL becomes a one-argument call, which is the same for both macros and is why the first two elements agree; a threading form with NO steps is its own value; and the last two are the sign difference again on a list step, where `thread-first' appends and `thread-last' prepends.
